name: Lokalise targets audit - language worker
description: Sub-workflow for the nightly targets audit: one language per call. Read-only Lokalise fetch, glossary + style-guide checks, OpenAI triage, returns findings only.

parameters.jsCode:
const prep = $('Run checks').first().json;
return [{ json: { iso: prep.iso, lang_name: prep.lang_name, strings_checked: 0, keys_seen: prep.keys_seen, candidates_total: 0, overflow: 0, triage_ok: true, glossary_conflicts: [], findings: [], errors: prep.errors.concat(prep.keys_seen === 0 ? ['no keys returned'] : []) } }];

parameters.content:
## Targets audit - language worker

Called once per target language by **Lokalise targets audit - nightly**. Fetches one language + EN (read-only token, 700 ms between pages), runs glossary + mechanical style-guide checks (*Run checks*), then the session checks added 2026-10-02 (*Extended checks*): plurals/CLDR, placeholders, $t() JSON, NFC, whitespace, Korean -니까? (deterministic) and accuracy, register verb forms, pt-BR vocabulary, typography, case, doubled words, same-source consistency (OpenAI triage). *Context guard* reads key names before consistency/glossary hits reach triage. Not checked: quotes, exclamation marks, zero-width characters (filtered in *Parse triage*, Maria 2026-10-02).

Successful runs are not saved (large payloads). Rules live in the parent workflow's *Build language jobs* node.
